answer: Require perturbed re-derivation: after submitting, each author receives their own answer with key terms swapped — the sonnet reworded, the plume recolored — and must bridge the altered text back to the same conclusion, in their own words, within minutes. A copying farm holds only the original wording and stalls; an agent that actually reasoned re-derives it easily. Copying stops paying when the text itself is no longer the asset.
